en: By the way, since I mentioned it before,
this Pi Web Access extension does add extra
tools to Pi. I mentioned before that Pi is
very minimal, just has a bunch of built-in
tools,
but you can add extra tools with your own
extensions, something we'll do later, or by
installing packages that add extra tools,
which the Pi Web Access package does. For
example, it adds a web search tool for Pi to
call, so not for you, but for Pi to call. It
also adds some internal documentation that
explains to Pi how to use that tool, and
that tool can then be used by Pye to run
that more capable web search. And there are
some other tools as well, like fetch_content
for downloading and extracting the content
from a website in a more readable Markdown
format and also get_search_content. And
there may be more tools added in the future,
of course. So that's just an example for
packages adding extra tools to Pye.
